component.name: StayProductive
component.summary: Plan focus sessions and block distractions locally

description.p: StayProductive is a local-first focus app for Linux. Profiles combine schedules, application rules, website rules, and daily or hourly limits, and a background daemon keeps enforcing them after the window is closed.
It is built for privacy and autonomy:

ul.li: No account, cloud service, telemetry, ads, or paywall.
Block reasons and end times are shown with every block.
Schedules, limits, strict commitments, and statistics survive restarts.
Strict mode uses commitments and cool-downs, not hidden root access.

description.p: Application blocking works on X11 and through an opt-in GNOME Shell extension. Website host rules and keyword replacement work in Chromium browsers through the bundled companion extension. Site time limits and in-page surfaces are not implemented yet and the application says so.
First packaged build: profiles, schedules, app limits, strict sessions, statistics, X11 and GNOME app enforcement, and a browser extension for host and keyword rules.
